```{r}
# Remove rows with missing values
domainome_data <- domainome_data[!is.na(AlphaMissense) & 
                                 !is.na(scaled_fitness)]
cat("Filtered rows:", nrow(domainome_data), "\n")  # 518686 
cat("Filtered unique domains:", length(unique(domainome_data$domain_ID)), "\n")  # 502 

# Transform AM score back to logits
# Define a small value epsilon
epsilon <- 1e-10
domainome_data[, AM_clamped := pmin(pmax(AlphaMissense, epsilon), 1 - epsilon)]
domainome_data[, AM_logit := log(AM_clamped / (1 - AM_clamped))]

# Extract mutation information
domainome_data <- domainome_data %>%
  mutate(
    mut_id = str_extract(uniprot_ID_mutation, "(?<=_).*"),
    mutation_position = as.numeric(str_extract(mut_id, "(?<=\\D)(\\d+)(?=\\D)"))
  )

# Split data by domain
domain_list <- split(domainome_data, by = "domain_ID")

# Compute R-squared for each domain
r_squared_values <- sapply(domain_list, function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) >= 3) {  # Skip domains with fewer than 3 points
    summary(lm(AM_logit ~ scaled_fitness, data = df))$adj.r.squared
  } else {
    NA
  }
}, USE.NAMES = TRUE)

# Convert to data frame
r_squared_df <- data.frame(
  domain = names(r_squared_values),
  adj.r.squared = r_squared_values
) %>% na.omit()

# Compute average R²
median_r_squared <- median(r_squared_df$adj.r.squared)
median_r_squared #0.1782415
```

```{r}
# We use path.expand to handle the "~" in the path correctly
data_dir <- path.expand("~/Documents/0.Projects/00.large_supplements/ProteinGym_v1.1/DMS_ProteinGym_substitutions")

# Get a list of all files with "Tsuboyama" in the name
file_list <- list.files(
  path = data_dir, 
  pattern = "Tsuboyama.*\\.csv$", # Regex: contains Tsuboyama and ends in .csv
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Define a function to read a single file and add the ID column
read_and_label_protein <- function(file_path) {
  
  # Extract just the filename (remove the directory path)
  file_name <- basename(file_path)
  
  # Logic to get the prefix:
  # Split the string by "_"
  # Example: "PITX2_HUMAN_Tsuboyama_2023_2L7M.csv"
  # becomes vector: c("PITX2", "HUMAN", "Tsuboyama", "2023", "2L7M.csv")
  parts <- str_split(file_name, "_")[[1]]
  
  # Combine the first two parts (Index 1 and 2) to get "PITX2_HUMAN"
  protein_id <- paste(parts[1], parts[2], sep = "_")
  
  # Read the CSV
  # show_col_types = FALSE keeps the console output clean
  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Add the new column
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(protein_name = protein_id) %>%
    relocate(protein_name, .before = 1) # Optional: move name to first column
  
  return(df)
}

# Map the function over the file list and combine into one DataFrame
# map_dfr automatically binds the rows of the resulting dataframes together
combined_df <- map_dfr(file_list, read_and_label_protein)

head(combined_df)
```

```{r}
unique_proteins <- unique(combined_df$protein_name)

# We query by 'id' (Entry Name) and ask for the 'accession' field
get_uniprot_accession <- function(protein_name) {
  
  # Construct the API URL
  # We use tryCatch to prevent the script from crashing if one ID is invalid or network fails
  tryCatch({
    base_url <- "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
    query <- paste0("query=id:", protein_name) # id: specifically targets Entry Name
    fields <- "fields=accession"
    format <- "format=json"
    
    url <- paste(base_url, paste(query, fields, format, sep = "&"), sep = "?")
    
    # Fetch and parse JSON
    # stream_in is overkill here, fromJSON works for simple endpoints
    result <- fromJSON(url)
    
    # Extract Accession
    if (length(result$results) > 0) {
      accession <- result$results$primaryAccession
      return(tibble(protein_name = protein_name, uniprot_id = accession))
    } else {
      warning(paste("No ID found for:", protein_name))
      return(tibble(protein_name = protein_name, uniprot_id = NA))
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error fetching:", protein_name, "-", e$message))
    return(tibble(protein_name = protein_name, uniprot_id = NA))
  })
}

# Loop through the proteins and fetch IDs
```

```{r}
# Define the function to fetch a single sequence
get_uniprot_sequence <- function(id) {
  # Base URL for UniProt FASTA format
  url <- paste0("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/", id, ".fasta")
  
  # Try to fetch the data
  tryCatch({
    response <- GET(url)
    
    # Check if request was successful (Status 200)
    if (status_code(response) == 200) {
      # Get content as text
      content_text <- content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
      
      # Split by newlines
      lines <- str_split(content_text, "\n")[[1]]
      
      # Remove the first line (the FASTA header starting with >) and empty lines
      seq_lines <- lines[!str_detect(lines, "^>")]
      seq_lines <- seq_lines[seq_lines != ""]
      
      # Combine remaining lines into a single string
      full_sequence <- paste(seq_lines, collapse = "")
      return(full_sequence)
      
    } else {
      warning(paste("Failed to fetch:", id, "- Status:", status_code(response)))
      return(NA)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error fetching:", id, "-", e$message))
    return(NA)
  })
}

id_mapping_df_fil_with_sequences <- id_mapping_df_fil %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(sequence = get_uniprot_sequence(uniprot_id)) %>%
  ungroup() # Remove rowwise grouping
```

```{r}
domain_wt <- combined_df_fil %>% filter (position == 1) %>%
  distinct(protein_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

domain_wt <- domain_wt %>%
  rowwise() %>% # We process one row at a time to handle string replacement correctly
  mutate(
    # Step A: Extract the Original Amino Acid (The first letter of the mutant string)
    # e.g., from "Y1A", we get "Y"
    original_aa = str_sub(mutant, 1, 1),
    
    # Step B: Create the WT sequence
    # We take the mutated sequence, go to 'position', and inject the 'original_aa'
    wt_sequence = {
      s <- mutated_sequence
      str_sub(s, position, position) <- original_aa
      s
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

domain_wt <- domain_wt %>% dplyr::select(protein_name, wt_sequence)
seq_mapping <- merge(domain_wt, id_mapping_df_fil_with_sequences, by = "protein_name")
seq_mapping
```

```{r}
# Define a function to read a single file and add the ID column
read_and_label_protein <- function(file_path) {
  
  # Extract just the filename (remove the directory path)
  file_name <- basename(file_path)
  
  # Split using literal dot: use fixed = TRUE OR escape the dot
  parts <- str_split(file_name, "\\.", simplify = TRUE)

  # Take the first part → e.g., "O00257"
  protein_id <- parts[1]
  
  # Read the CSV
  # show_col_types = FALSE keeps the console output clean
  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
    # Add the new column
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(protein_name = protein_id) %>%
    relocate(protein_name, .before = 1) # Optional: move name to first column
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
# Create a combined dataframe for plotting
r2_combined <- bind_rows(
  r_squared_df %>% mutate(source = "Domainome 1.0"),
  mega_r_squared_df %>% mutate(source = "Mega-scale")
)

# Count summaries
n_domainome <- length(unique(r_squared_df$domain))
n_var_domainome <- nrow(domainome_data)

n_mega <- length(unique(mega_r_squared_df$domain))
n_var_mega <- nrow(mega_combined)

# Median R²s
med_domainome <- median(r_squared_df$adj.r.squared) #0.1782415
med_mega <- median(mega_r_squared_df$adj.r.squared) #0.2242278

# Rename column to standardize
r2_combined <- r2_combined  %>%
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("Domainome 1.0", "Mega-scale")))

# Plot
p1 <- ggplot(r2_combined, aes(x = source, y = adj.r.squared, fill = source)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, color = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, color = "grey", alpha = 0.7) +
  #stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.4, color = "black", fatten = 1) +
  geom_point(stat = "summary", fun = median, shape = 18, size = 4, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("Median R²: ", round(..y.., 3))),
            stat = "summary", fun = median, vjust = -1, size = 4.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0.87, label = paste0(n_domainome, " domains\n", format(n_var_domainome, big.mark = ","), " variants"), size = 4.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.87, label = paste0(n_mega, " domains\n", format(n_var_mega, big.mark = ","), " variants"), size = 4.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 1), expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
  labs(
    title = "Protein Domains",
    subtitle = paste(n_domainome + n_mega, "domains"),
    x = NULL,
    y = expression("R² between abundance and AlphaMissense logits")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#82b3a6", "#8ecf63")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
